subject: Post-call: security & data residency (Stellara)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lorenzo Costa <lorenzo.costa@stellara.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + security asks

Hi Lorenzo — great to meet you on the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

Call summary:
- Use case: real-time summarization + customer support routing for EU patient support teams.
- Traffic profile: ~200 concurrent users at peak, average prompt length ~120 tokens, expected growth 40% over 6 months.

Security/compliance items (we flagged on the call):
1) SOC 2 status: can you share whether Stellara requires the vendor to have SOC 2 Type II, or is SOC 2 in process acceptable? If you have a supplier security questionnaire template, I can route it to our security team.
2) Data residency: you asked about EU-only hosting and whether data crosses borders. We can run Dedicated or Private with EU-only tenancy — I'll confirm specifics below, but need to know whether you will accept Dedicated (single-tenant GPU pools) or require on-prem/VPC.
3) Cross-border transfer / export controls: you mentioned export-control concerns (OFAC/ITAR). Please confirm if there are specific country export restrictions we should be aware of.

Attached: our standard vendor security questionnaire (RWI-VSQ-20260511.pdf) to give you a sense of the items our InfoSec team will request. If easier, reply to this thread with your procurement contact or attach your security template.

Proposed next steps:
- You: share any existing vendor security questionnaire and a short note on residency/export restrictions.
- Us: confirm EU hosting options and provide a short ops note on cross-border handling.
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up next week with Rishi to walk through the technical residency options.

Would Wed or Thu next week work for a quick follow-up?

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: RWI-VSQ-20260511.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Lorenzo Costa <lorenzo.costa@stellara.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephen Holt <stephen.holt@stellara.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + security asks

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary, very helpful. A few notes from our side: 

1) SOC 2: our procurement bucket prefers SOC 2 Type II, but we can accept vendors that are "SOC 2 in progress" if there's a clear timeline and compensating controls. Please include expected SOC 2 milestone dates if available.
2) Residency: Stellara requires that patient data for EU operations remain within the EU. We prefer vendors that can guarantee EU-only processing and storage (including backups). Can you confirm which Redwood deployment modes provide that guarantee?
3) Export controls: we do have a list of restricted jurisdictions we cannot transfer data to. ITAR is not applicable to our clinical data, but we do have OFAC-related restrictions; I can share a spreadsheet of countries.

I've attached a short privacy brief and our procurement intake email. Also: our legal team will want to see a DPA and info on subprocessors.

Happy to jump on the follow-up with Rishi — Wed 14:00 CET works for us.

Best,
Lorenzo Costa
Director, IT Security
Stellara Therapeutics
lorenzo.costa@stellara.com | +44 20 7946 07 11

Attachments: stellara-privacy-brief.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + security asks — Stellara (please advise)

Folks — forwarding the Stellara thread. Key asks from Lorenzo: EU-only residency requirement, SOC 2 milestones, OFAC country list, and DPA/subprocessor detail.

Immediate items for internal action:
- Rishi: can we confirm the exact residency guarantee wording for Dedicated vs Hosted? Lorenzo explicitly wants EU-only processing and backups; need language we can share with procurement.
- Priyom: can you prep a short ops note (1-pager) describing how we isolate data in Dedicated and Private, and whether backups / snapshots may replicate out-of-region for DR. If Dedicated cannot guarantee immutable EU-only backups out of the box, note mitigations.
- Also attaching our vendor questionnaire we sent them (RWI-VSQ-20260511.pdf).

I've penciled in Wed 14:00 CET for the technical follow-up — can you confirm availability and whether we should include a Solutions Engineer?

Thanks — want to keep this tight, Stellara looks time-sensitive on compliance.

-Marissa
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RWI-VSQ-20260511.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lorenzo Costa <lorenzo.costa@stellara.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap + security asks — Stellara (please advise)

Thanks for the forward, Marissa — quick responses below so we can get back to Lorenzo before the Wed call.

SOC 2:
- Status: Redwood's Hosted API is covered under our SOC 2 Type II assessment in progress; expected completion Q3 2026 (we can share milestone evidence). Dedicated and Private deployments are customer-isolated and typically covered under customer attestations; we'll provide a mapping doc for controls coverage.

Data residency (short):
- Private deployment (VPC / on-prem) = customer fully controls where data lives; can guarantee EU-only.
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pools deployed in customer-specified region) = can be provisioned in eu-west-1 or eu-central-1 and we can guarantee compute+storage remain in that region. Backups/snapshots: by default we keep backups in-region for Dedicated; for Hosted there's cross-region replication for availability but we can offer a contractual regional isolation option for enterprise accounts (requires SLA/cost discussion).

Cross-border / export controls:
- Redwood is a US company; export controls (OFAC) and sanctions apply. We do not host or process in sanctioned countries. If Stellara has a specific country list, we'll run it through our compliance process and confirm any legal constraints. ITAR: not relevant for clinical data typically; flag to Legal if they believe ITAR applies.

Next steps I recommend we propose to Lorenzo:
- Share a 1-page residency guarantee for Dedicated/Private and the SOC 2 milestone events (we'll attach these to the call invite).
- Assign a Solutions Engineer to the Wed 14:00 CET call to walk technical isolation and DPA items.
- Ask for Stellara's restricted-jurisdiction spreadsheet prior to the call.

I'll attach a short internal note on EU ops and the draft residency wording for review (internal-eu-ops-note.txt).

-Rishi
VP, Solutions & Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

Attachments: internal-eu-ops-note.txt (text/plain)
